title: Authenticated Principal to Sesh Creator Resolution Boundary
objective: Resolve an authenticated canonical PrincipalId to a canonical SeshCreatorId only through the explicit PrincipalSeshCreatorMappingRepository, while preserving authentication failures, distinguishing an authenticated but unprovisioned principal, failing closed on identity or persistence inconsistency, and granting no Sesh project authorization.
resolutionFlow: Resolve canonical authenticated PrincipalId using SessionPrincipalResolver.
Return unauthenticated without consulting Sesh mappings when no authenticated principal exists.
Preserve authentication infrastructure failure as unavailable.
Return unmapped when the authenticated PrincipalId has no explicit canonical Sesh mapping.
Treat mapping storage, validation, conflict, thrown provider failure, malformed creator identity, or PrincipalId mismatch as unavailable.
Return PrincipalId and SeshCreatorId only after both canonical identity boundaries agree.

inferenceRules.rule: SeshCreatorId is resolved exclusively through the explicit canonical PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId mapping.

authorizationBoundary.resultMeans: The currently authenticated PrincipalId is explicitly associated with the returned SeshCreatorId.

nextSlice.title: Sesh Project Ownership Authorization Architecture
scope: Define authorization separately from authenticated creator identity resolution.
Define how SeshMusicProject.ownerCreatorId is checked against the authenticated SeshCreatorId.
Do not treat PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId mapping as project ownership.
Define fail-closed ownership read and mutation authorization contracts.
Keep collaborator authorization separate unless explicitly modeled.
Do not create public creator-owned APIs.
Do not create production identity, creator, project, or mapping data.

nonGoals: Creating a PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId mapping
